[Intro]
[Cadd9]
[G]
[Em7]
[Dsus4]Hey, homecoming

[Verse 1]
[Cadd9]queen Why do you lie?
[G]When somebody's mean
[Em7]Where do you hide?
[Dsus4]Do people assume
[Cadd9]You're always alright?
[G]Been so good at smi-
[Em7]ling Most of your life
[Dsus4]Look damn

[Pre-Chorus]
[Cadd9]good in the dress
[G]Zipping up the mess
[Em7]Dancing with your best
[Dsus4]foot forward
[Cadd9]Does it get hard
[G]To have to play the part?
[Em7]Nobody's feeling sor-
[Dsus4]ry for ya

[Chorus]
[Cadd9]But what if I told
[G]you the world wouldn't end
[Em7]If you started show-
[Dsus4]ing what's under your skin
[Cadd9]What if you let
[G]them all in on the lie
[Em7]Even the home-
[Dsus4]coming queen cries

[Post-Chorus]
[Cadd9]
[G]Oh
[Em7]
[Dsus4]Hey, homecoming

[Verse 2]
[Cadd9]queen How's things at home?
[G]Still walking on egg-
[Em7]shells When that curtain is closed?
[Dsus4]Did your Daddy teach
[Cadd9]you How to act tough?
[G]Or more like your Ma-
[Em7]ma Sweep it under the rug?
[Dsus4]Look damn

[Pre-Chorus]
[Cadd9]good in the dress
[G]Zipping up the mess
[Em7]Dancing with your best
[Dsus4]foot forward
[Cadd9]Did you want the crown?
[G]Or does it weigh you down?
[Em7]Nobody's feeling sor-
[Dsus4]ry for ya

[Chorus]
[Cadd9]What if I told
[G]you the world wouldn't end
[Em7]If you started show-
[Dsus4]ing what's under your skin?
[Cadd9]What if you let
[G]them all in on the lie?
[Em7]Even the home-
[Dsus4]coming queen cries
[Cadd9]Yeah, what if I told
[G]you the sky wouldn't fall?
[Em7]If you lost your compo-
[Dsus4]sure, said to hell with it all
[Cadd9]Not everything pret-
[G]ty sparkles and shines
[Em7]And even the home-
[Dsus4]coming queen cries

[Outro]
[Cadd9]Oh yeah
[G]
[Em7]Even the home-
[Dsus4]coming queen cries
[Cadd9]Mmmmmm,
[G]mmm
[Em7]
[Dsus4]Hey, homecoming
[Cadd9]queen Why do you lie?
[G]When somebody's mean
[Em7]Where do you hide?
